senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) wicked man, wrongful claimant.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 27a:13">Snh. 27ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 23:1">Ex. XXIII, 1</cite>) <he>אל תשת ר׳ עד</he> allow not a wicked man to be witness. Ib. 9ᵇ <he>ר׳ הוא והתורה אמרה וכ׳</he> he is a (self-confessed) wicked man, and the Law says, allow not &c. Ib. <he>אין אדם משים עצמו ר׳</he> none can incriminate himself (his testimony against himself has no legal effect). Ib. 27ᵃ <he>ר׳ דחמס בעינן</he> (to be disqualified in court) he must be a wicked man connected with violence (but you cannot disqualify a sinner against ceremonial laws).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 20:2">Gen. R. s. 20</cite> <he>נחש זה ר׳ בעל תשובות</he> that serpent is a wicked creature rich in arguments.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 8a:14">Bekh. 8ᵃ</cite> <he>ולאותו ר׳ לא וכ׳</he> and to that wicked creature (the serpent) I find no parallel in nature (as to duration of pregnancy).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ab. V, 19</cite> <he>בלעם הר׳</he> Balaam the wicked; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>רְשָׁעִים</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:1">Ib. 1</cite> <he>להפרע מן הר׳ וכ׳</he> in order to punish the wicked who ruin the world &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 1:8">Ib. I, 8</cite> <he>וכשיהיו … יהיו בעיניך כר׳</he> when disputants stand before thee (the judge), look upon both parties as wrongful claimants, opp. <he>זכאין</he>.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:15">Ib. IV, 15</cite> <he>אין … משלות הר׳ וכ׳</he> it is beyond our power to understand why the wicked are prosperous or why the righteous suffer.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110b:9">Snh. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>קטני בני רִשְׁעֵי ישראל</he> young children of wicked Israelites; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 13:1">Tosef. ib. XIII, 1</cite> <he>רשעי ארץ</he> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 13:2">Ib. 2</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 9:18">Ps. IX, 18</cite>) <he>אלו ר׳ ישראל</he> this refers to Israelitish sinners.
<cite ref="Horayot 10b:17">Hor. 10ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 8:14">Koh. VIII, 14</cite>) <he>כמעשה חר׳ של עוה״ב</he> like that which happens to the wicked in the world to come.
Snh. 93ᵃ רִשְׁעֵיהֶם של ישראל the wicked (idolaters) of the Israelitish people; a. v. fr.—Fem. רְשָׁעָה.
<cite ref="Berakhot 61b:6">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>מלכות הר׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the wicked (Roman) government.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 35">Ex. R. s. 35</cite> <he>אדום הר׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="M01579"><he>מלכות</he></cite>); a. fr.
